summary: Implemented the Change-Risk Classifier module (Task 14) for GossipMesh to evaluate file changes, line counts, sensitive paths, auth modifications, migrations, dependencies, infrastructure code, shell scripts, security code, and test coverage. It categorizes changes into LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL risk levels, mandates approvals for MEDIUM and above, and blocks CRITICAL changes by default. Comprehensive unit tests were also added in tests/test_change_risk.py.

import pytest
from gossipmesh.enterprise.risk_classifier import ChangeRiskClassifier, ChangeDetails, RiskLevel

def test_low_risk_classification():
    classifier = ChangeRiskClassifier()
    details = ChangeDetails(
        files_changed=["gossipmesh/utils.py"],
        additions=10,
        deletions=2,
        has_tests=True
    )
    result = classifier.classify(details)
    assert result.risk_level == RiskLevel.LOW
    assert result.requires_approval is False
    assert result.blocked is False

def test_medium_risk_classification():
    classifier = ChangeRiskClassifier()
    details = ChangeDetails(
        files_changed=["gossipmesh/api/routers/users.py"],
        additions=120,
        deletions=40,
        has_dependencies_change=True
    )
    result = classifier.classify(details)
    assert result.risk_level == RiskLevel.MEDIUM
    assert result.requires_approval is True
    assert result.blocked is False

def test_high_risk_classification():
    classifier = ChangeRiskClassifier()
    details = ChangeDetails(
        files_changed=["gossipmesh/auth/authorization.py", "alembic/versions/123_migration.py"],
        additions=600,
        deletions=100,
        has_auth_change=True,
        has_migrations=True
    )
    result = classifier.classify(details)
    assert result.risk_level in (RiskLevel.HIGH, RiskLevel.CRITICAL)
    assert result.requires_approval is True

def test_critical_risk_classification():
    classifier = ChangeRiskClassifier()
    details = ChangeDetails(
        files_changed=[f"gossipmesh/auth/file_{i}.py" for i in range(10)],
        additions=3000,
        deletions=500,
        has_auth_change=True,
        has_migrations=True
    )
    result = classifier.classify(details)
    assert result.risk_level == RiskLevel.CRITICAL
    assert result.blocked is True
    assert result.requires_approval is True
